parameters.name: DEPTH
parameters.valid_range: DEPTH >= 1; arbitrary non-power-of-two values are legal

parameters.name: dtype
parameters.valid_range: The benchmark projection and evaluator use the default packed logic type

parameters.name: ADDR_DEPTH
parameters.valid_range: Derived internally by fifo_v3 from DEPTH. Neither the submission nor evaluator may override the DUT's ADDR_DEPTH. A verification property module may declare a same-named mirror parameter only so the public bind wrapper can forward fifo_v3's already-derived value.

reset.assertion_effect: Control pointers and occupancy clear without waiting for a rising clock edge; stored data also clears.
reset.deassertion_contract: The test environment deasserts reset away from the active clock edge before applying stimulus.

transaction_semantics.push_accept: At a rising edge with rst_ni=1 and flush_i=0, a push is accepted exactly when push_i && !full_o.
transaction_semantics.pop_accept: At a rising edge with rst_ni=1 and flush_i=0, a pop is accepted exactly when pop_i && !empty_o.
transaction_semantics.simultaneous_push_pop: When both operations are accepted, the pre-edge head is popped, data_i is appended at the tail, ordering is preserved, and occupancy is unchanged. In FALL_THROUGH mode at empty with push_i && pop_i, data_i is transferred combinationally and occupancy remains zero.
transaction_semantics.full_boundary: At current occupancy DEPTH, full_o=1. A push is not accepted even if pop_i is high; a legal full-boundary pop decreases occupancy by one.
transaction_semantics.empty_boundary: With FALL_THROUGH=0 at occupancy zero, empty_o=1 and pop is not accepted. With FALL_THROUGH=1 and push_i=1, empty_o is combinationally deasserted and data_o equals data_i.
transaction_semantics.ordering: Every accepted, non-bypassed push is returned exactly once by accepted pops in FIFO order; a fall-through empty push/pop returns that input without storing it.
transaction_semantics.legal_stimulus: Every binary push_i/pop_i combination is legal at every occupancy. A push while full_o or a pop while empty_o is not accepted and must not corrupt state; flush_i and reset take precedence over transactions.

state_semantics.occupancy: The abstract occupancy is in [0, DEPTH]; accepted push only increments, accepted pop only decrements, and simultaneous accepted push/pop is stable.
state_semantics.usage_encoding: usage_o equals occupancy modulo 2**ADDR_DEPTH. Consequently a full power-of-two DEPTH encodes as zero, while non-power-of-two full occupancy is exactly representable.
state_semantics.full_empty: For DEPTH>=1, full_o is true exactly at occupancy DEPTH. Except for FALL_THROUGH combinational push behavior, empty_o is true exactly at occupancy zero.
state_semantics.reset_state: Asserting rst_ni low clears pointers, occupancy, and stored data; full_o=0 and empty_o=1 when push_i=0.
state_semantics.flush_state: At a rising edge with rst_ni=1 and flush_i=1, pointers and occupancy clear; reset has higher priority and no transaction is accepted.
state_semantics.memory_after_flush: Stored array contents after flush are not part of the interface contract; empty status prevents their observation until overwritten by later accepted pushes.

latency_semantics.registered_mode: With FALL_THROUGH=0, data_o reflects the current stored head; a newly accepted push into an empty FIFO becomes a stored head after the accepting edge.
latency_semantics.fall_through_mode: With FALL_THROUGH=1 and occupancy zero, push_i makes data_o equal data_i combinationally and deasserts empty_o.
latency_semantics.empty_data: data_o is don't-care for verification while empty_o=1, except the documented FALL_THROUGH input bypass.

invalid_parameter_behavior.invalid_domain: DEPTH < 1, DATA_WIDTH < 1, or a submission/evaluator override of fifo_v3's ADDR_DEPTH that differs from the derived expression. Forwarding the DUT's derived value into the property-module mirror parameter is valid.
